reader_contract: The reader receives only the original prompt and final question. It never receives the answer or HotpotQA support labels. It seeds deterministic BM25 retrieval and expands exact document-title links. Evidence is replayed after the unchanged full 16K prompt.
nested_scale_rule: The graph-ranked document list is a strict prefix schedule of 2, 3, and 4 documents as model parameters increase. Fixed ASCENT always receives one graph-ranked document.
primary_estimand: paired per-example Foundation minus scale-ASCENT teacher-forced answer NLL
official_secondary_metric: NVIDIA RULER string_match_part under greedy decoding

ceiling_aware_secondary_estimand.interpretation: fraction of Foundation's remaining error eliminated; a perfect ASCENT endpoint equals 1.0 and is not required to exceed the accuracy ceiling
ceiling_aware_secondary_estimand.undefined_case: If Foundation itself equals 1.0, the task has no measurable accuracy headroom and the endpoint is labeled saturated rather than failed.

controls.fixed: one graph-ranked document at every model scale
controls.query_only: the scale-matched number of deterministic BM25 documents without title-graph expansion
controls.irrelevant: the scale-matched number of bottom-ranked documents outside the BM25/title frontier whenever possible

safe_gate: Each evidence path is enabled only if its paired calibration NLL gain has a positive normal-approximation 95% lower confidence bound. A closed gate exactly copies Foundation official predictions while retaining path NLL for diagnosis.

development_success_rule.scale_gain: The paired scale-ASCENT NLL-gain 95% LCB is positive at every endpoint.
development_success_rule.scale_complementarity: Both adjacent differences in paired scale-ASCENT NLL gain and the per-example slope on log model parameters have positive 95% LCBs.
development_success_rule.fixed_control: Scale ASCENT beats Fixed ASCENT in paired NLL at 1.5B and 3B with positive 95% LCBs.
development_success_rule.retrieval_control: Graph Scale beats query-only BM25 at 3B with a positive paired NLL 95% LCB.
development_success_rule.irrelevant_control: Graph Scale beats the same-count irrelevant replay at every endpoint with positive paired NLL 95% LCBs.
development_success_rule.systems: All prompts remain native and untruncated, hashes/commit/clean-tree invariants pass, scale document prefixes are nested, and raw persistent-state bytes per model parameter strictly decrease.
development_success_rule.accuracy: Report absolute official gain and frozen remaining-error elimination together. Accuracy saturation cannot fail the continuous primary gate or demand accuracy above 1.0.

promotion_rule: This single frozen panel is development only. Only a complete pass may authorize three untouched official HotpotQA task seeds and a preregistered confirmatory analyzer; partial success cannot be tuned on this panel and called confirmation.
failure_rule: Any missed primary/control/system gate is retained as a development failure. Accuracy saturation is labeled ceiling-limited, not a reversal, and does not permit post-score metric substitution.
